items.information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) - [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents another competition held in UC Berkeley! - Gift cards to SpeedCubeShop will be provided to all 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in each event! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2NzM3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--39d4604caacd6b9abe7f1d40fa870948cb5da415/LogoBLDRL.png) Pirmā ātrkubošanas līga Latvijā! Sacenties par **Rīgas Blind meistara** titulu! Ņemiet vērā, ka šajās sacensībās **nebūs** populāro disciplīnu (2x2, 3x3, pyraminx u.tml.)! Pārliecinieties kārtīgi, vai šīs sacensības ir piemērotas Jūsu prasmēm! Ierobežotās telpas dēļ līdzi atļauts ņemt **tikai 1 viesi** uz dalībnieku. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The first speedcubing league in Latvia! Compete for the title of **Riga Blind Master**! Please note that this competition does **not** hold the popular events (2x2, 3x3, pyraminx etc.)! Check carefuly if this is a kind of competition You would be able to participate in! Competition will take place in a limited space. You may bring at most **only one guest** per competitor.
